order.next.label: Next steps and the other party
handover.terms_intro: Read every point. You can see the code only after you accept all of them.
handover.terms.1: You alone are responsible for checking the item. Open it, test it fully, and compare it with the listing photos and description before you do anything else. Take as long as you need.
handover.terms.2: When the seller enters the code, you accept everything a reasonable check at the meetup would show, and the order counts as delivered. After that you can only claim a hidden fault that you could not see at the meetup, for example a false battery health reading, a locked or blocked phone, or a counterfeit, and you must prove it. Damage or wear that you could see is not claimable.
handover.terms.3: The code is yours alone. Give it only to the seller, in person, after you have checked the item. Never give it before you hold the item, and never send it by message, call or through another person. If you share it any other way, any loss is yours.
handover.terms.4: Meet only in a busy public place in daylight, and bring someone if you can. Never go to a private place. You are responsible for your own safety.
handover.terms.5: If the item is not as described, or you feel pressured or unsafe, do not give the code. Leave, and ask the seller to cancel the order. While you do not give the code, your money stays held.
handover.terms.6: Do not pay or promise anything outside TrustBazaar, in cash or by transfer. Anything done outside TrustBazaar is not protected.
handover.terms.7: If you do not follow any one of these points, and you lose money, the item or anything else because of it, TrustBazaar is not responsible and owes you no refund or compensation. The loss is your own responsibility. This does not limit any right that the law gives you and that cannot be excluded.
handover.terms_check: I have read and understood every point above, and I accept them.
courier.terms_intro: Read every point. You can choose courier delivery only after you accept all of them.
courier.terms.1: The delivery fee shown is fixed for this order and is paid with it. The quote runs out at the time shown. After that you must ask for a new one.
courier.terms.2: You alone are responsible for giving a complete and correct address and contact name. If the parcel cannot be delivered because of a wrong or incomplete address, any loss or extra cost is yours.
courier.terms.3: Be reachable and ready to receive the parcel. If you are not there or do not answer, the courier may return the parcel to the seller, and TrustBazaar is not responsible for the delay or the loss that follows.
courier.terms.4: Check the parcel before you accept it. If it looks opened, wet or damaged, do not accept it. Record one continuous video from the closed parcel to the item taken out, with the courier's label visible. That video is your main evidence. Without clear evidence, TrustBazaar may be unable to decide in your favour.
courier.terms.5: Never pay cash or anything extra to the courier. Your payment is already held by TrustBazaar. Anything you pay outside TrustBazaar is not protected.
courier.terms.6: Confirm receipt only after you have checked the item. If you do not open a dispute within the dispute window after delivery, the payment is released to the seller and cannot be recovered through TrustBazaar.
courier.terms.7: The courier is an independent company. Delivery dates are estimates. For a parcel that never arrives or arrives damaged, open a dispute within the dispute window; TrustBazaar decides it under its rules.
courier.terms.8: If you do not follow any one of these points, and you lose money, the item or anything else because of it, TrustBazaar is not responsible and owes you no refund or compensation. The loss is your own responsibility. This does not limit any right that the law gives you and that cannot be excluded.
courier.terms_check: I have read and understood every point above, and I accept them.
dispute.terms_intro: Read every point. The dispute is opened only after you accept all of them.
dispute.terms.1: Open a dispute only for a real problem, and tell the truth. A false or misleading statement, or edited, staged or computer-made evidence, can make TrustBazaar reject the dispute, release the money to the seller and suspend your account.
dispute.terms.2: Opening a dispute freezes the payment until TrustBazaar decides. You can withdraw it before the decision, but you cannot open the same kind of dispute again.
dispute.terms.3: You alone are responsible for your evidence. Give clear photos and videos of the item, the damage, the packaging and the courier label. TrustBazaar decides on the evidence it has. If it is missing, unclear or too late, your claim can be rejected.
dispute.terms.4: For a parcel, record one continuous, uncut video from the closed parcel to the item taken out. Show the label, the seals and the problem. A video that is cut or does not show the parcel being opened may not be accepted.
dispute.terms.5: You may be asked to send the item back. Send it back in the condition you received it, within the time given. If you do not, the refund can be refused.
dispute.terms.6: Answer questions within the deadlines shown. A missed deadline can end your case without a decision in your favour. Keep the discussion inside TrustBazaar, and do not threaten or harass the other party.
dispute.terms.7: Your evidence and statements may be shown to the other party and to the TrustBazaar staff member who decides the case.
dispute.terms.8: If you do not follow any one of these points, or you open the dispute too late, and you lose money, the item or anything else because of it, TrustBazaar is not responsible and owes you no refund or compensation. The loss is your own responsibility. This does not limit any right that the law gives you and that cannot be excluded.
dispute.terms_check: I have read and understood every point above, and I accept them.
